story.title: Story 1: Thread, Actor, Message, And Part Store

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior blocker `story1-thread-association-heuristic` and directly touched association surfaces. Reviewed the quick-fix artifact, confirmed production code now uses target-key lookup rather than cwd/generated-path managed-thread fallback, confirmed identity-preservation guards around metadata updates, checked new regression tests for the prior reproduction and alias-rewrite path, audited touched production paths for fake/shim/workaround behavior, and ran the configured story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by code and test evidence. `findManagedThread()` now delegates directly to `findThreadByTarget()` with only `runtime`, `sessionId`, and `sessionFilePath` (`src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:219-225`), while the prior `cwd` / `currentGeneratedFilePath` compatibility lookup helpers are absent from the touched store code. `updateThreadMetadata()` now calls `assertTargetIdentityPreserved()` before rewriting thread metadata (`src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:416-419`), and that guard prevents session id or session file removal/reassignment (`src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:950-982`). Tests now cover the original collision case by proving two sessions sharing only `cwd` create distinct threads (`tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts:201-257`) and cover alias-based identity rewrite rejection (`tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts:887-928`). `npm run verify` and `npm run verify-all` both passed.

additionalObservations: Production-path audit of the touched files found no material fake adapter, mock path, shim, placeholder branch, or non-real runtime workaround related to the prior blocker.
`npm run verify-all` exited successfully, but its integration phase reported `No integration tests found.` The configured gate still passed.
